english_title: Problem 2: A 2024 Mathematical Analysis Entrance Exam Problem
statement_en: Let $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy that for every $x_0 \in [a,b]$, one has $\lim_{x\to x_0} f(x)=0$. Then $f$ is Riemann integrable on $[a,b]$ and its integral is $0$.
